title: Zephyr: SenderID field support
description: Implement 10-byte extended SenderID field in Zephyr
notes: Verified complete against the controlling current link profile. The bead's legacy 10-byte SenderID wording is superseded by spec/drafts/draft-lichen-link-01.md §§3.1-3.4 and spec/02-physical-link.md §4, which mandate an 8-byte canonical signer EUI-64 SIID with LLSec SI bit 7 paired exactly with signature bit 5. Existing frame.c/link.h support bounded parse/write, reject S/SI mismatches and non-8-byte SIIDs, include SIID in frame sizing, and round-trip canonical signed vectors byte-for-byte. Validation: fresh host CMake build with UBSan; ctest 1/1 passed; frame_test 16/16 passed, including canonical broadcast/short/signed-max vectors and malformed policy cases. git diff --check clean for the scoped files. Verification-only: no files modified by this worker.
